description: Use this when the user asks for the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) of a company, including a KYB or vendor onboarding check, for example "what is the LEI of Siemens AG?", "whose LEI is W38RGI023J3WT1HWRP32?" or "is the LEI of this German company still active?". Pass the company name (and a country code to narrow it) or the 20-character LEI. Returns each entity's LEI, legal name, status, legal form code, country and city, national registration number and the LEI's renewal dates. Sole proprietors are left out. Do not use it to find a private person, for companies that have no LEI (most small businesses), or for financial or credit information.

country.description: Two-letter country of the legal address to narrow a name search, for example DE.

lei.description: A 20-character Legal Entity Identifier to look up directly.

name.description: Company or organisation name to search for. Send either name or lei.

name: find_company_lei
title: Look up a Legal Entity Identifier
